scope: opt-in local software root/intermediate/all registered JWK authority rotation; trusted host and network-isolated custodian
publication: leaf pause/ack; old-root-signed sequential manifest; overlapping service trust; quiescent JWK/CA activation; all-leaf issuer migration; TLS/reload receipts; remove old trust; deny all old JWKs; retire owned old secret files
limits: software encrypted vault and its high-entropy password share a local volume; not HSM or physical air gap
trusted host coordinator controls Docker and can run the custodian; no root vault/socket on online CA or leaf controller
root manifest sequence assumes intact local state; no distributed consensus or storage rollback resistance
issuer-only rotation does not actively revoke a stolen old intermediate; root retirement/pins/expiry differ from CRL/OCSP
brief CA restart/issuance pause and failed in-flight requests are possible; no HA or zero-downtime SLA
unlink is not physical/memory/backup erasure; no production deployment or independent team reproduction
